videos.title: Cem Karsan: A 25% S&P Decline Before June, Starting Before March
videos.description:
Cem Karsan on the beaten down AI infrastructure names: liquidity to the neoclouds has completely dried up, and any fast move higher over the next two or three weeks should be read as short covering, not a bottom. His words, that would be an opportunity to fade and turn short. He calls it a structural short, and the reason is what he sees behind it: an S&P decline of 25% or more before June, really starting before March.

videos.title: Cem Karsan Sees a 25% S&P Decline, Really Starting Before March
videos.description:
Cem Karsan puts a number and a date on it: an S&P decline of 25% or more before June, really starting before March. The reasoning is a cap that has been on this market since rates and credit default swaps spiked in October, a credit market he says has completely dried up, and macro that works over quarters rather than weeks. Nearer term he lays out two paths, with December opex second most likely and January the most likely.
